title: Fleet
description: One airline's current fleet, published as fleets/{airline_id}.json and loaded when the user zooms into that airline. Rules JSON Schema can't check: airline_id matches the file name and an entry in airlines.json; as_of equals manifest.data_as_of; the aircraft count and per-family counts match that airline's fleet_count and family_counts; an airframe appears in at most one fleet file.

aircraft.description: Aircraft in the fleet, in circle-pack slot order: family ascending, then built ascending, then reg ascending, then id ascending. Null built and reg values sort last. The app fills pre-laid-out slots in this order, so it must be stable.

aircraft.title: FleetAircraft
aircraft.description: One aircraft as shown in the circle pack. Full history lives in aircraft/{id}.json.

id.description: Stable airframe ID, {manufacturer}-{programme}-{msn}. Stays the same across re-registrations and operator changes.

reg.description: Current registration, or null if unknown.

type_code.description: ICAO type designator for the exact variant, or null if unknown.

family.description: Type family the aircraft is grouped under. Never null: aircraft whose type can't be mapped use the family 'other'.

built.description: When the aircraft was built (first flight or delivery, whichever is known first), or null if unknown.

status.description: Status within this fleet, or null if unknown. active: in service; stored: parked or in long-term storage. Consumers must handle values added later.

previous_operator_count.description: Number of operators before the current one. 0 means the aircraft is known to have had no earlier operator; null means its history is unknown.

thumb.description: Photo of the aircraft for the circle pack, or null if none is available. The app falls back to a family silhouette.
